notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
A player has at least four cards in hand.
description:
Cast Whispering Madness from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand, then causing you to draw at least four cards, then create that many Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{B}.
Repeat.
